digest.overview: 本期焦點是記憶體與先進封裝擴產持續升溫:南亞科第三季獲利創新高,並大幅上修資本支出至 697 億元;三星與 SK 海力士資本支出合計 88 兆韓元;中芯國際產能利用率升至 97.3%,記憶體與晶圓代工的 PVD 與靶材需求可望增加。封裝端,輝達擴大台灣供應鏈合作,矽品、景碩簽長約擴產,CPO 產品進入量產。靶材廠方面,江豐電子已打入台積電並赴港募資進軍零部件;光洋科以電子廢棄物提煉黃金的回收技術打進台積電供應鏈;有研新材股價漲停、資金大舉流入。貴金屬方面,金價在 3,850 美元附近的一年低點盤整,白銀小幅反彈。
key_trends: 南亞科、三星、SK 海力士大舉投資,記憶體擴產帶動 PVD 需求
輝達擴大台灣供應鏈合作,矽品等先進封裝長約擴產
江豐電子打入台積電並擴充零部件業務
貴金屬回收技術成為靶材供應鏈競爭力
金價在一年低點附近盤整
watch_points: 南亞科 697 億元資本支出的設備與靶材採購時程
台積電、三星德州擴產決策
美國 AI 晶片新限制對韓系記憶體擴產的影響

papers.title: Effect of Nb2O5-TiO2 Co-doping on the Properties of ITO Targets
papers.abstract: Abstract With the development of high-performance high-end display devices and the iterative upgrading of photovoltaic cells, higher requirements have been imposed on ITO targets. The preparation technology for ITO targets with high carrier mobility has therefore become a research focus in related fields. Conventional ITO targets have relatively low carrier mobility (30–40 cm²·V⁻¹·s⁻¹), making it difficult to meet the performance requirements of transparent conductive oxide targets for the next generation of high-end displays and photovoltaic devices. In this study, 0.1 wt% Nb 2 O 5 and 0.1 wt% TiO 2 were co-doped into an indium tin oxide powder (In₂O₃:SnO₂ = 9:1, wt%). After die pressing and cold isostatic pressing, ITO green bodies were prepared and sintered in an oxygen atmosphere at 1450°C for 6 h, yielding an ITO target with a relative density of 99.54%, a resistivity of 1.940×10⁻⁴ Ω·cm, and a carrier mobility of 57.4 cm 2 ·V − 1 ·s − 1 . The results showed that an appropriate amount of Nb 2 O 5 -TiO 2 co-doping could improve the carrier mobility of ITO targets. In addition, Nb 2 O 5 -TiO 2 co-doping could reduce the sintering temperature of the ITO target from 1550°C to 1450°C. This study achieved the preparation of an ITO target with high density and high mobility while reducing the sintering temperature, providing a reference for the development of low-temperature sintering processes for high-performance ITO transparent conductive targets and for research on TCO materials for high-end displays and photovoltaic devices.
papers.summary: 在 ITO 粉末中共摻 0.1 wt% Nb2O5 與 0.1 wt% TiO2,經模壓與冷均壓後於氧氣氛 1450°C 燒結 6 小時,得到相對密度 99.54%、電阻率 1.940×10⁻⁴ Ω·cm、載子遷移率 57.4 cm²/V·s 的靶材,並將燒結溫度由 1550°C 降至 1450°C。
papers.title_zh: Nb2O5-TiO2 共摻雜對 ITO 靶材特性的影響
